result.summary: Scope test run independently against `git diff main...HEAD` (not assumed from the handoff note). Changed files touching engine code: lib/letflow/engine/expr.ex (new, 442 lines) and lib/letflow/engine/transition.ex (dispatch_exclusive_gateway/4 rewrite, +evaluate_conditioned_edges/2,3, +advance_token/3). Ran `git diff main...HEAD -- lib/letflow/engine/expr.ex lib/letflow/engine/transition.ex | grep -niE "repo\.|tenant_id|prefix|schema_name|System\.get_env|password|secret|token"` -- the only hits are the pre-existing English word 'token' (Token struct / gateway 'token' domain concept, unrelated to auth tokens) and 'variables_prefix' (a string-manipulation helper name, not an Ecto :prefix). No Repo.*, no tenant_id, no Ecto :prefix/schema_name, no System.get_env, no secret material anywhere in the diff. Both modules operate purely on in-memory structs (InstanceState, Token, Graph, Node, Edge) passed in by the caller and return computed values -- no DB call, no network call, no file I/O, consistent with transition.ex's own moduledoc contract ('All state is passed in; all output is returned. No DB, no network, no clock.') which this diff explicitly preserves and extends rather than breaks. Also checked docs/requirements.yaml and handoffs/*.json changes in the diff -- non-code bookkeeping only, no tenant-data path. Conclusion: out of scope -- no tenant-data path touched (no API route, no migration, no secret resolution, no response-shaping for a tenant entity, no lookup-by-ID handler). No INV-1..INV-8 'How to verify' procedures were applicable to run.
